about: Reference material for the Rental Housing Law Navigator task. Source: participant starter pack.

rule_record_schema.title: Rule record (one per rule extracted from the corpus)

jurisdiction.description: State code ('CA','NJ','MA') or 'City, ST' (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA').

status.description: As of the query date (default 2026-10-01). Enacted laws with a future effective date are 'not_yet_effective'.

key_value.description: The headline number or formula, e.g. '1.5 months rent', 'lesser of CPI or 4%'.

coverage_conditions.description: Who/what is covered: year built or certificate-of-occupancy cutoffs, unit counts, owner type.

overrides.description: team_rule_ids this rule supersedes or yields to, with direction in 'interaction'.

quoted_span.description: Exact text copied from the source document that supports the rule.

sample_rule_record.title: Rent Security Deposit Act
sample_rule_record.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed one and one-half months' rent.
sample_rule_record.exemptions: Owner-occupied premises with 2 or fewer units (unless tenant opts in); seasonal rentals

change_tests.title: California AB 325 / SB 763 takes effect
change_tests.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective before, applies after, for every CA address.

change_tests.title: Hoboken vs Jersey City local algorithmic bans
change_tests.expected_behavior: HOB-ALG-01 only for Hoboken addresses; JC-ALG-01 only for Jersey City addresses; neither for Newark.

change_tests.title: NJ FAIR Act: enacted, not yet effective; possible preemption
change_tests.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective on 2026-10-01, applies on 2027-07-02 for every NJ address; Jersey City and Hoboken addresses carry a conflict flag for human review.

change_tests.title: Massachusetts pending bills S.2983 and H.5222
change_tests.expected_behavior: Reported as pending (not in force) for every Boston and Cambridge address; affected set = all MA addresses if enacted.

change_tests.title: Massachusetts rent-control ballot question struck
change_tests.expected_behavior: No rent cap reported for any Boston or Cambridge address; IP 25-21 recorded as failed. Affected set is empty.
